initiative.title: Business Lanes Finance Implementation
initiative.summary: Prepare finance implementation planning outputs from the lane playbook with explicit pricing, cost, and external-effect boundaries.

taskset.summary: Build finance/accounting execution packets (pricing-policy assumption, cost evidence, and decision boundaries) from the playbook contract.

tasks.title: Create finance policy evidence packet for execution planning
tasks.goal: Produce draft finance-accounting evidence packets and boundary controls that the finance lane can use to progress to implementation with owner-approved scope.
tasks.scope: Draft finance policy evidence files only; no pricing/cost stateful writes or external accounting system mutations.
acceptance: A finance policy evidence packet and decision trigger list exists.
Revenue, margin, and cost assumption fields are explicit and labeled draft/verified status.
External-effect safeguards and approval boundaries are preserved.
Task/unit evidence and closeout are ready for W4 closure.

units.title: Draft finance policy evidence packet
units.context: This unit creates draft finance-accounting evidence artifacts from the lane playbook: pricing assumptions, cost evidence draft, and decision trigger matrix.
units.scope: Docs only: finance evidence packet draft and boundary controls.
steps: Draft the finance policy evidence artifacts in `agents/project/WORK-LANE-PLAYBOOKS.md` under a finance lane subsection.
Add explicit draft/verified fields for pricing assumption, margin guardrails, and cost capture scope.
List required owner approvals and external-effect boundaries for pricing/cost changes.
Add taskset closeout evidence commands and generate verification records.
acceptance: Finance lane draft packet is present and explicitly marked draft-only.
Boundary constraints and approval triggers are explicit.
Task and unit evidence requirements are measurable via executable commands.
units.stop_condition: Stop after finance evidence packet draft and closeout evidence links are ready for owner review.
units.handoff: Report finance draft packet location, approval triggers, and verified evidence.
